name: Split peas
description: Dried peas split and hulled — they collapse into soup rather than holding shape.

tcm.note: Read with peas, which are neutral and spleen-strengthening.

ayurveda.note: Shita and ruksha, like the other cooling pulses.

effects.note: A systematic review and meta-analysis of nine randomised feeding trials found meals built around roughly 160g of pulses — about a cup, cooked — left people reporting about 31% greater fullness than a calorie-matched meal without them, credited to the fibre, protein and low glycaemic load pulses bring to a plate. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
